Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    r2=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if 2 in r][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    # shift every 4 down one
    for i,j in seeds:
        ni,nj=i+1,j
        if 0<=ni<h and g[ni][nj]==0: out[ni][nj]=4
    # bottommost 4 above the 2-row emits diagonal rays from its shifted position
    bottom=max([s for s in seeds if s[0]<r2],key=lambda p:p[0])
    apex=(bottom[0]+1,bottom[1])
    for di,dj in [(1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)]:
        ii,jj=apex[0]+di,apex[1]+dj
        while 0<=ii<h and 0<=jj<w and g[ii][jj]==0 and out[ii][jj]==0:
            out[ii][jj]=4; ii+=di; jj+=dj
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def paint(g, si, r2):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def free(i,j): return 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==0 and out[i][j]==0
    for s in sorted(si,key=lambda p:-p[0]):   # bottom-most first
        (si_,sj)=s
        for di,dj in [(-1,-1),(+1,+1)]:    # only down-right & up-left diagonals
            i,j=s[0]+di,s[1]+dj
            while free(i,j):
                out[i][j]=4; i+=di;j+=dj
    return out

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    r2=[i for i in range(h) if 2 in g[i]][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,j in seeds:
        t=r2 if i<r2 else h-1
        # only seeds whose dropped position sits directly above the bar get rays
        if t>r2-2 and t<i+1: pass
    # simpler: repaint only where expected; validate structure: every seed drops one row,
    # the lowest seed whose drop touches the bar emits up-diag rays until bar/occupied.
    for i,j in seeds:
        t=r2 if i<r2 else h-1
        out[t][j]=4
    emitter=max([(i,j) for i,j in seeds if i<r2],key=lambda p:p[0])
    ti,ti_j=emitter[0]+1 if emitter[0]<r2 else h-1, emitter[1]
    for di,dj in ((-1,-1),(-1,1)):
        ii,jj=ti+di,ti_j+dj
        while 0<=ii<h and 0<=jj<w and g[ii][jj]==0:
            out[ii][jj]=4; ii+=di;jj+=dj

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    r2=[i for i in range(h) if 2 in g[i]][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def paint(i,j): return 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==0
    # drop every seed to just above the bar (if above) or bottom row (if below)
    for i,j in seeds:
        t=r2-1 if i<r2 else h-1
        kk=i+1
        while kk<=t and paint(kk,j): out[kk][j]=4; kk+=1
        if paint(t,j): out[t][j]=4
    # emitter = lowest seed above the bar; its stem emits two upward diagonals to the edge
    em=max([p for p in seeds if p[0]<r2],key=lambda p:p[0])
    ti,ti_j=em[0]+1,em[1]
    for di,dj in ((-1,-1),(-1,1)):
        ii,jj=ti+di,ti_j+dj
        while paint(ii,jj): out[ii][jj]=4; ii+=di;jj+=dj
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    r2=[i for i in range(h) if 2 in g[i]][0]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==4]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def zero(i,j): return 0<=i<h and 0<=j<w and g[i][j]==0
    # erase all seeds
    for i,j in seeds: out[i][j]=0
    # stem one row below every seed
    for i,j in seeds:
        t=i+1
        if t<h and zero(t,j): out[t][j]=4
    # emitter = lowest seed above the bar; its stem emits two upward diagonals
    em=max([p for p in seeds if p[0]<r2],key=lambda p:p[0])
    ti,tj=em[0]+1,em[1]
    for di,dj in ((-1,-1),(-1,1)):
        ii,jj=ti+di,tj+dj
        while zero(ii,jj): out[ii][jj]=4; ii+=di; jj+=dj
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
